question: Is there a free plan?
answer: Yes. The Free plan costs nothing and includes 1 agent.
alt_questions: Do you have a free tier?

question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
answer: Yes. You can upgrade at any time and the change applies immediately. Downgrades apply at the next renewal.

question: Do you offer annual billing?
answer: Annual billing is available on request. Contact sales@beacon.example.

question: What is the money-back guarantee?
answer: If you are not happy tell us within 14 days of buying and we will give you all your money back.

question: Do prices include VAT?
answer: Yes. All prices on the pricing page include VAT.

question: Do you have an education programme?
answer: Our education programme gives schools free access to the Team plan for one year.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Email help@beacon.example or use the chat widget in the app.
